summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial evaluates how well a diabetes drug called omarigliptin works in real-world settings for people with type 2 diabetes, which is a condition where the body cannot properly process sugar. The study plans to include 938 participants. The Bangladesh Institute of Research and Rehabilitation in Diabetes, Endocrine and Metabolic Disorders is sponsoring the research. The current status of the trial is Unknown status.
